title: Tenant timeline view
description: Per-tenant chronological view of all notes, sorted by occurredOn.
acceptanceCriteria: Timeline sorts by occurredOn, not createdAt
Editing a note's occurredOn re-sorts it correctly in the timeline

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Built alongside LODGY-24 (note CRUD) - same screen pair. NotesTimelineScreen (ui/note/NotesTimelineScreen.kt) observes TenantNoteDao.getByTenantId(tenantId), which already queries `ORDER BY occurredOn DESC` - AC1 holds with no new query needed. AC2 ('editing occurredOn re-sorts correctly') holds structurally: the screen collects that Flow reactively via NotesTimelineViewModel, so any occurredOn edit through NoteFormScreen re-triggers the query and the row moves to its new position automatically - there's no separate cached/ordered list that could go stale. Each note renders as a row with a type-colored dot (COMPLAINT amber, DAMAGE red, GENERAL blue) per the wireframe, plus the note text and formatted occurredOn date. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. On-device pass still queued (see LODGY-24's note on the emulator limitation) - worth confirming visually that adding a note with a backdated occurredOn inserts it in the right timeline position, not just at the top.
